categories.main_business_segments: Paraca Inc. operates primarily in the development, operation, and management of hourly parking lots in Japan. Its business is classified into 'leased parking lots,' 'owned parking lots,' and 'others,' which include real estate leasing, vending machine income, solar power generation, and management of motorcycle and bicycle parking facilities. The company does not have separate reportable business segments, as over 90% of its revenue comes from parking-related operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core operational methods involve the installation and management of unmanned, automated parking equipment (such as payment machines and locking devices) on leased or owned land. Standardization is emphasized in site selection, parking space design, operations, and pricing, supported by proprietary operational know-how and an in-house sales support system. The company also utilizes IT for operational efficiency and data-driven decision-making.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Paraca serves a broad range of end users who require short-term parking, primarily targeting urban drivers in major metropolitan areas. Its customers include individual vehicle owners, commercial facility users, and, to a lesser extent, monthly contract users. The company also engages with landowners for site acquisition and with real estate developers for facility-attached parking projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are concentrated in Japan, with a focus on major metropolitan areas such as the Kanto and Kansai regions, but also covering other core cities nationwide. All sales and assets are located within Japan, and there is no overseas business.
categories.supply_chain_position: Paraca operates at the downstream end of the parking and real estate value chain, directly providing parking services to end users and managing parking facilities. It also acts as an intermediary between landowners and parking users, and in some cases, as a property owner.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, Paraca prioritizes expanding its portfolio of owned parking lots to reduce contract cancellation risk and stabilize earnings. The company focuses on standardization, operational efficiency, and regional market leadership. While it does not conduct traditional R&D, it invests in IT systems, operational process improvements, and sustainability initiatives such as forest conservation and solar power generation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated from hourly parking fees, with some monthly parking contracts. Additional income streams include real estate leasing, vending machine commissions, and solar power generation. The business model is stock-based, emphasizing recurring revenue from a growing base of managed parking spaces.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Paraca competes with other parking lot operators in Japan, such as Park24 and Times24, but differentiates itself by focusing on owned parking lots, which is less common among peers. The company positions itself as a leading pure-play parking operator with a strong presence in core urban markets and a high proportion of stable, owned assets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending September 2025, Paraca reported revenues of 17.63 billion yen, operating profit of 3.27 billion yen, and net profit of 2.04 billion yen, with total assets of 49.44 billion yen and equity of 20.91 billion yen. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profit over the past five years, with a 7.6% year-on-year revenue increase and record-high operating and net profits.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Paraca’s value proposition lies in its ability to provide reliable, conveniently located parking solutions in urban areas, supported by a stable portfolio of owned lots that reduce operational risk. The company emphasizes operational excellence, standardization, and regional market leadership, offering landowners and users a trustworthy, efficient, and sustainable parking service.
